<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" id="Definitions_RoboticBurgerSeller" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/robotic-burger-seller">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_RoboticBurgerSeller" name="Robotic Burger Seller near the University of Vienna" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderReceived" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderToAsk</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AskMenuOrBurger" name="Ask whether customer wants menu or just burger">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderToAsk</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AskToMenuChoice</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MenuChoice_Split" name="Menu wanted?" default="Flow_BurgerOnly">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AskToMenuChoice</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MenuYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BurgerOnly</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderToAsk" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_AskMenuOrBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskToMenuChoice" sourceRef="Task_AskMenuOrBurger" targetRef="Gateway_MenuChoice_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuYes" name="Menu" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuChoice_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Menu_Parallel_Split">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${wantsMenu}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BurgerOnly" name="Just burger" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuChoice_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Burger_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Menu_Parallel_Split" name="Start menu preparation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MenuYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ParSplit_Drink</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ParSplit_Side</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParSplit_Drink" sourceRef="Gateway_Menu_Parallel_Split" targetRef="Task_PrepareDrink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParSplit_Side" sourceRef="Gateway_Menu_Parallel_Split" targetRef="Task_AskFriesOrWedges"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDrink" name="Prepare drink (duration depends on size)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ParSplit_Drink</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Drink_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AskFriesOrWedges" name="Ask whether customer wants fries or wedges">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ParSplit_Side</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Ask_SideSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Drink_Join" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDrink" targetRef="Gateway_Menu_Parallel_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ask_SideSplit" sourceRef="Task_AskFriesOrWedges" targetRef="Gateway_SideChoice_Split"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SideChoice_Split" name="Fries or wedges?" default="Flow_Wedges">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Ask_SideSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Fries</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wedges</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fries" name="Fries" sourceRef="Gateway_SideChoice_Split" targetRef="Task_PrepareFries">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${friesSelected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wedges" name="Wedges" sourceRef="Gateway_SideChoice_Split" targetRef="Task_PrepareWedges"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFries" name="Prepare fries (duration depends on size)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Fries</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FriesToSideMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareWedges" name="Prepare wedges (duration depends on size)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wedges</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WedgesToSideMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriesToSideMerge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFries" targetRef="Gateway_Side_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WedgesToSideMerge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareWedges" targetRef="Gateway_Side_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Side_Merge" name="Side prepared">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FriesToSideMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WedgesToSideMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SideMerge_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SideMerge_Join" sourceRef="Gateway_Side_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Menu_Parallel_Join"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Menu_Parallel_Join" name="Drink and side ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Drink_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SideMerge_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_BurgerMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_BurgerMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_Menu_Parallel_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Burger_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Burger_Merge" name="Ready for burger preparation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BurgerOnly</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_BurgerMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BurgerMerge_Prep</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BurgerMerge_Prep" sourceRef="Gateway_Burger_Merge" targetRef="Task_PrepareBurger"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareBurger" name="Prepare burger (duration depends on number of ingredients)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BurgerMerge_Prep</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Burger_Deliver</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_StatusTimer" name="Every 30 seconds" attachedToRef="Task_PrepareBurger" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StatusTimer_Update</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_Status">
        <bpmn:timeCycle xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">R/PT30S</bpmn:timeCycle>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StatusUpdate" name="Give enthusiastic status update">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StatusTimer_Update</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StatusUpdate_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusTimer_Update" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_StatusTimer" targetRef="Task_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_StatusSent" name="Status update given">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StatusUpdate_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusUpdate_End" sourceRef="Task_StatusUpdate" targetRef="EndEvent_StatusSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Burger_Deliver" sourceRef="Task_PrepareBurger" targetRef="Task_DeliverByConveyor"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverByConveyor" name="Deliver order via conveyor belt">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Burger_Deliver</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Deliver_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deliver_End" sourceRef="Task_DeliverByConveyor" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderDelivered" name="Order delivered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Deliver_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
